text:
olivia: heads up — we're seeing a spike of orphaned spans after the nightly retention job. ~4k traces where the final child spans are missing and the exporter shows successful uploads. sample trace id: 0xabc123def

olivia: quick paste of suspicious logs:
```
2026-03-20T03:12:10Z exporter-s3 INFO upload succeeded key=traces/2026-03-20/0xabc123.json size=14kb
2026-03-20T03:12:11Z retention-cleaner INFO listing prefix=traces/2026-03-20/
2026-03-20T03:12:11Z retention-cleaner INFO deleting s3://redwood-traces/traces/2026-03-20/0xabc123.json run_id=run-6572
```

olivia: looks like a delete happened immediately after upload. @raj can you confirm exporter finalization flow? :eyes:

raj: looking. are those uploader logs from the same instance as the exporter? can you paste exporter logs around 03:12:10?

olivia: here's the exporter snippet, pretty short:
```
2026-03-20T03:12:09Z exporter DEBUG flush started trace=0xabc123
2026-03-20T03:12:10Z exporter INFO s3 put-object OK key=traces/2026-03-20/0xabc123.json
2026-03-20T03:12:10Z exporter INFO mark-finalized trace=0xabc123
```

raj: hmm exporter claims mark-finalized but we don't have a separate manifest write. we rely on eventual consistency + s3 head checks downstream. if retention lists and deletes aggressively we can race.

maria: retention-cleaner here — the job runs list+delete for any objects older than retention cutoff. it runs every hour and this run_id=run-6572 completed at 03:15. schedule hasn't changed. we didn't see any retries logged.

sam: can we pause the cleaner for the next hour? mitigate while we figure root cause. also opening incident bridge. @oncall-bridge-bot can you start a bridge for eng-platform? :rotating_light:

oncall-bridge-bot: bridge created: https://zoom.redwood/bridge/INC-2026-03-20-23 (ops-led) — join for triage.

ingest-bot: alert: trace-orphan-rate > 1000/min for 5m. dashboard: https://grafana.redwood/d/trace/orphaned-spans

maria: pausing cleaner now — set flag retention-cleaner.pause=true for run-6573. retention-cleaner-bot will confirm when the current run finishes.

retention-cleaner-bot: run-6572 finished. pause applied; next run skipped.

raj: short-term fix: exporter should write a small zero-byte .done marker key after upload and we should have cleaner ignore objects without a .done older than X minutes. i'll sketch a change. long-term we should switch to a manifest/finalize transaction.

maria: we can also add a 5m quarantine window before delete (or move to quarantine prefix). easier to roll out quickly.

olivia: counts — i grepped S3 list logs and matched ~3.9k keys deleted in that window where exporter reported put-object within 2s prior.

sam: action items: 1) retention paused (maria) 2) raj to open PR for done-marker (small change) 3) maria to add quarantine prefix + CI toggle 4) olivia to run re-ingest backfill for deleted keys where we still have local exporter logs.

raj: opened draft PR: https://git.redwood/repo/infra/PR-4123 — adds .done marker and cleaner ignore logic.

maria: i'll add the quarantine toggle and a short runbook note:
- when retention paused: set retention-cleaner.pause=true and monitor orphan rate
- to revert quickly: re-enable after confirming finalization markers are in place

olivia: re-ingest started against backfill pipeline. i pushed a small script to stash exporter logs to tmp and replay for those trace ids. progress: ~600 traces re-ingested so far.

sam: nice. let's keep postmortem short and add telemetry: metric for delete-after-upload latency, and alert if delete occurs < 5m after put-object.

olivia: agreed. will add dashboard panel and create an alert threshold. thanks team. :thumbsup:
